_comment: Expansion 3 part E.5: spells outside battle - locks and stone, weather and land (docs/expansions/03-demigods-magics.md). Numbers from the 2024 Player's Handbook. Done in game/stonework.py (road ops 'lock', 'mend', 'hand', 'make', 'stone', 'chest', 'weather', 'plants', 'wave'; kinds in rules/spells.E5_KINDS); Move Earth is a camp ward ('earthworks'), Control Water a lasting buff ('part_water'), Plant Growth's Overgrowth a zone in a fight ('overgrowth') and its Enrichment a use on the road ('road_too': 'plants').

knock.name: Knock
knock.text: A locked door or chest within 60 feet opens, with a loud knock heard 300 feet away: the whole level knows. In the cells, the lock is no bar: only the run.

arcane_lock.name: Arcane Lock

material.text: gold dust worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

arcane_lock.text: A door beside you locks for good to all but the party: nothing that lives there opens it. In a town it locks your room at the inn: no thief gets in.

mending.name: Mending
mending.text: A break or a tear closes: the most worn thing the party carries is mended a little, up to three-quarters sound (the last of the wear needs tools).

mage_hand.name: Mage Hand
mage_hand.text: A spectral hand reaches 30 feet: your next theft from a stall is done by it (Advantage), and if you are caught nobody can grab your wrist.

fabricate.name: Fabricate
fabricate.text: Raw stuff you carry becomes things: any camp craft, up to three batches, without tools, fire or a check. A craft of an artisan's tools needs someone trained with them.

creation.name: Creation
creation.text: Shadow stuff becomes a thing you have seen: of wood, cloth or rope for 24 hours, of stone for 12. Then it is gone, and no merchant will buy it.

stone_shape.name: Stone Shape
stone_shape.text: You shape stone like clay: a way opens through 5 feet of wall beside you, for good.

passwall.name: Passwall
passwall.text: A passage opens through up to 20 feet of wall for an hour; when it closes, anyone in it is put out where it began.

move_earth.name: Move Earth
move_earth.text: The earth round the camp slowly heaves into a ditch and a bank: whatever comes in the night is seen climbing it, and you are awake to meet it.

leomunds_secret_chest.name: Leomund's Secret Chest

material.text: a chest of rare materials worth 5,000+ GP and its tiny replica worth 50+ GP

leomunds_secret_chest.text: Your coin and treasure, or your spare arms, go into a chest hidden on the Ethereal Plane: weightless, safe from every thief. Touch the replica to call it back.

control_water.name: Control Water
control_water.text: For ten minutes a river parts before you: the next one is crossed on its dry bed, with no ford to wade and nobody wet.

control_weather.name: Control Weather
control_weather.text: For 8 hours the weather for miles round obeys you: clear the sky, bring rain or snow, still the wind, or warm or cool the air. Under the open sky only.

plant_growth.name: Plant Growth
plant_growth.text: In a fight, the plants round a point grow thick: every foot through them costs four, but the ground round your friends is left clear. Over 8 hours, the land's food is doubled for a year.

tsunami.name: Tsunami
tsunami.text: When a band on the road is seen first, a wall of water rises and falls on it before the fight: 6d10 bludgeoning, a Strength save for half.
